title: 2026 California Voter Guide / Guía de votantes de California
notes: Orange, Riverside and San Bernardino county locals and the Fourth District Court of Appeal omitted; all U.S. House, Assembly and Senate entries kept (some are outside LA County). Where the page says 'X or Y' / 'Choose between one of the two', both are recorded as support. Retention judges listed 'YES'. Ballot measures omitted.

removed: Either-or picks left out (8 entries): a choice between two isn't an endorsement of both.
verify.note: '2026 California Voter Guide', 'Election Day is November 3, 2026', last updated 10/16/26; all 140 entries confirmed (fetched with curl). Page misspellings kept as transcribed: 'Kurt Gonksa' and 'Sue Himmerlich' (ballot: Kurt Gonska, Sue Himmelrich), 'Ricardo Ortega-Martinez' (ballot: Ricardo Ortega, AVCCD Area 2). Either-or picks on the page: Santa Monica Council 'Brett Morrow or Doug Tressler', West Hollywood 'Jonathan Cottrell or Stephen Post', Superior Court Office 87 (Bayne or DeJute) and Office 131 (Ross or Tryfman) 'choose between one of the two'. Centinela Valley UHSD Trustee Area 5 (Estefany Castañeda) is on the page but no matching contest was found in content/contests/ca-la/2026-11-03.json. Measure positions and the 'Whittier School Board District 5' line (matches Whittier City SD Trustee Area 5 on the ballot) noted.

note: Transcribed from the page by a researcher. Hospitality workers' union (hotel, airport, stadium workers in Southern California); its membership's endorsements. General election: ""Election Day is November 3, 2026." / "Las elecciones son el 3 de noviembre, 2026.""
